note: Wooded campground on top of the Niagara Escarpment above Lake Winnebago, the west rows along the cliff edge; the lake, beach and marina are below. Horse trailers use a separate lot by the dump station for the park's bridle trail; there is no horse camping. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, campground map, horse page and trail map, closures feed, OSM and imagery read; GoingToCamp refuses (fees $25-50 unconfirmed). 112 sites, 32 electric incl. host 58E; showers May-mid-Oct, flush, vault, water, dump. Entrance-road construction notice (office and road stay open). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: STATUS: DNR notice 'Construction near the park office and entrance road will begin in mid Sept. 2026 and continue through spring 2027. The office and entrance road will remain open' (low impact; no campground closure). The Oct 5-Nov 15 2026 trail closure has ended.
NOTE: dropped '2-night minimum in season' (the state:WI policy row holds it) and the 'equestrian area' remark (no horse camping; only a horse-trailer parking lot near the dump station).
SEASON: no campground season on the DNR page (hosts on site April-October; showers about May to mid-October); nothing stored, nothing written.
AMPERAGE and rig lengths: not on DNR pages; nothing written.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The loops sit under continuous canopy on top of the escarpment; Lake Winnebago is ~200-300 m west, below the cliff, through forest. (The stored evidence's 'woods/farmland' misreads the algae-green lake as farmland; the call stands.)
FEES: $25-50 from the 2026-10-10 GoingToCamp capture; unconfirmed today (403).
PIN 44.1513,-88.2970 is ~65 m from the OSM campground node (44.15102,-88.29774). Fine.
PHONE 920-989-1106 confirmed; WEBSITE https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/highcliff live; GoingToCamp link kept.
